study type: Case report within a prospective observational study
exposure: Uterus transplantation with robotic-assisted laparoscopic donor surgery
cohort: A 33-year-old woman with uterine absence who underwent uterus transplantation from her 62-year-old mother
finding: This case report demonstrates the feasibility of robotic-assisted laparoscopy in uterus transplantation, with successful live birth and uneventful follow-up, paving the way for less invasive donor procedures.
mod_finding: The patient underwent an elective cesarean section at 36(+1) weeks gestation.
